HQL Reports: Export HQL

- improved the ability to download a particular HQL report, using UniTime/export?output=hql-report.csv URL
- academic session can be selected using term parameter
- HQL appearance and admin-only permissions are checked (the user must have the appropriate permissions to be able to get the report)
- report parameter can contain name of the report (instead of unique id)
- individual report...

result.reasoning: This commit "HQL Reports: Export HQL" introduced the else branch that unconditionally creates and adds a SavedHQLInterface.IdValue for single-choice parameters (like SUBJECT/DEPARTMENT), without checking whether `value` (retrieved from helper.getParameter) is null. The fix commit adds precisely the missing `if (value != null)` guard around this exact logic block, confirming this commit as the origin of the bug.
